[ cf BHS avekṣavant], full of longing or desire (for, loc.) ; Vin IV 214, 14 (avassutā nāma sārattā °-vatī paṭibaddhacittā, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee °-vā); M I 32, 20 (kulaputtā … sāmaññe °-vanto); III 227, 36 (vighātavā ca °-vā ca, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee wr upekhavā); S III 16, 13 (°-vā); Th 558 (sāsanasmiṃ °-vā); Ja V 453, 10* (nārinaṃ vasagato °-vā); Ap 250, 3 (tam ahaṃ assamaṃ gacchiṃ phalahattho °-vā; Ap-a 476, 8 : °-vā aturito saṇikaṃ assamaṃ gañchin ti attho?); — neg. anapekkhava(t), anapekhava(t), mfn. , M I 32, 11 (puggalā assaddhā … sāmaññe anapekhavanto) = A III 199, 4 ; Th 600; Ja I 141, 25* (kāmesu anapekkhavā); Nidd I 159, 16 ; — anapekkha , anapekha , mfn. , free from desire; paying no regard, indifferent; disinterested ; Vin II 16, 27 (gahapati ~o virattarūpo mayī ti); A III 6, 13 (yato … so kumāro vuddho hoti … ~ā dāni … dhāti tasmiṃ kumāre hoti); Sn 200 (so mato seti … susānasmiṃ ~ā honti ñātayo); Th 707 (n’ atthi cetasikaṃ dukkhaṃ ~assa); Ja V 179, 21* (~o pabbajasi); Paṭis I 42, 30 (kāye ca jīvite ca ~ānaṃ pariccattajīvitānaṃ); Bv 2:8 (imaṃ pūtikāyaṃ … chaḍḍayitvāna gaccheyyaṃ ~o anatthiko); Vism 613, 19 (~-taṃ upaṭṭhapeti); Sadd 415, 9 (~o chaḍḍayi); — nirapekkha , mfn. , id. ; Ja IV 286, 16 (~o hutvā pakkāmi); Sv 583, 24 (kāye ca jīvite ca ~-tāya) ≠ Pj II 503, 32 (~-ttā); Spk II 239, 24 ; — sâpekkha , sâpekha , mfn. , 1. having a longing (for); with longing ; Vin I 265, 11 (~o vā pakkamati paccessan ti); D II 77, 16 (yāvakīvaṃ ca bhikkhave bhikkhū āraññakesu senāsanesu ~ā bhavissanti); III 43, 28 (taṃ ~o pajahati); A III 295, 18 foll. (mā kho tvaṃ gahapati ~o kālam akāsi, dukkhā … ~assa kālakiriyā); Nidd-a II 82, 28 (kāye ~-tāya); — 2. ( gr.t.t. ) dependent; needing an attribute ; Sadd 744, 19 (~-padassa); 763, 27 (~-tte sati pi); — see also uttaragāthāpekkhapada.

sāpekkha.p: [ saha + apekkhā + a ] (ti) Google Translate (1) Affection-attachment-lust-indulgence-lust-having. (2) Negokot-foreseeable.
